items.title_zh: 智元宣布与首批 20+ 高校合作，投入超 2 亿元建设具身智能人才生态
items.title_en: AgiBot Partners With 20+ Universities, Investing Over 200 Million Yuan in Embodied AI Talent Ecosystem
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，智元本周发布公告，“ 元苼生态发展计划 ”与国内众多高校开展合作，共建具身智能产教融合创新实践平台。 基于具身智能真实教学与科研需求， 智元将投入千台具身智能设备 ，双方将进行课程共建、课题共研、实训共育，打通产业前沿技术与高校人才培养的衔接壁垒。 首批合作的 20 多所高等院校包括北京大学、清华大学、浙江大学、华南理工大学、上海交通大学、西安交通大学、东南大学、中山大学等。 智元将投入包括精灵、灵犀、远征在内的轮式、半尺寸和全尺寸人形机器人以及酷拓四足机器人，投入机型覆盖了智元全系列本体产品，投入总数超过一千台，解决高校机器短缺的问题。 同时， 智元还将提供 AIMA 开发平台 ，为高校系统化教学、学生自主研发提供完整工具支撑。作为智元推出的具身智能全域技术生态底座，AIMA 包含灵心平台 LinkSoul（具身智能体开发应用平台）、灵创平台 LinkCraft（机器人综合智能创作平台）、精灵平台 Genie Studio（一站式全流程具身作业智能平台），为高校学生提供“硬件真机实训 + 软件平台研发”的双轨教学体系。 依托全套软件生态，高校学子可系统性学习具身智能软硬件原理、完成模型训练、算法调试、场景开发、任务实现与二次开发等，实现从理论学习到真机落地的完整闭环。 本次智元提供机器本体与软件会员权益的总额达到 2 亿 。 智元也将探索建立常态…
items.summary_en: AgiBot has launched its "YuanSheng" ecosystem plan with more than 20 Chinese universities, including Peking University, Tsinghua and Shanghai Jiao Tong, to build an industry-education platform for embodied AI. The company will supply over 1,000 embodied AI devices spanning its humanoid and quadruped lineup and provide its AIMA development platform, with robots and software benefits valued at over 200 million yuan.
items.why_zh: 具身智能落地的关键瓶颈之一是人才与真机实训资源，头部企业以千台设备和平台向高校开放，有望打通从理论学习到真机落地的培养闭环。
items.why_en: Talent and hands-on hardware access are key bottlenecks for embodied AI, so a leading player opening over a thousand robots and its platform to universities could close the loop from classroom learning to real-robot deployment.

items.title_zh: WorkBuddy发布DeepSeek模型服务异常补偿公告
items.title_en: WorkBuddy Issues Compensation Notice Over DeepSeek Model Service Disruption
items.summary_zh: WorkBuddy发布DeepSeek模型服务异常补偿公告 搜狐
items.summary_en: WorkBuddy has issued a notice offering compensation for an anomaly in DeepSeek model services. Publicly available information only confirms the notice itself, with the timing, scope and compensation terms not yet disclosed.
items.why_zh: 第三方大模型服务一旦出现异常，会直接波及依赖它的应用，此类补偿公告也提醒开发者关注外部模型服务的稳定性与兜底机制。
items.why_en: Disruptions at third-party model providers directly hit the applications built on them, making such compensation notices a reminder of the stability and fallback risks of relying on external model services.

items.title_zh: 共同进化，分道扬镳：自改进智能体中的技能—策略协同进化陷阱
items.title_en: Evolving Together, Failing Apart: The Skill-Policy Co-evolution Trap in Self-Improving Agents
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 新论文关注自改进智能体中的“技能—策略协同进化”范式，即策略模型与技能库在训练过程中相互提升。现有评估方式是在训练所用的最终技能库（交付库）上给协同进化后的策略打分。但论文指出，部署之后技能可能被改写、增删，其频率高于策略模型的重训练，于是策略实际运行在一个已经漂移的技能库上；这一情形既未被训练目标覆盖，也未被现有评估协议处理。论文由此刻画了所谓“技能—策略协同进化陷阱”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Skill-policy co-evolution, in which an agent's policy model and its skill bank improve each other during training, is a promising paradigm for self-improving agents. Current evaluations score the co-evolved policy on the final bank it trained with (the delivered bank). After deployment, however, skills may be rewritten, added or removed more frequently than the policy model is retrained, leaving the policy to operate on a drifted skill bank that neither the training objective nor existing evaluation protocols address. In this paper, we first esta…
items.why_zh: 它揭示出现有自改进智能体评估默认技能库在部署后保持稳定，这一被忽视的假设可能在真实使用中失效。
items.why_en: It exposes an unstated assumption in current evaluations of self-improving agents — that the skill bank stays stable after deployment — which can break in real use.

items.title_zh: 多层级 AI 可及性模型（MAIAM）：面向全面前沿 AI 安全的按比例访问与能力限制
items.title_en: A Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model (MAIAM): Proportionate Access and Capability Limits for Comprehensive Frontier AI Safety
items.summary_zh: 关于能力强大的 AI 系统如何发布，多数争论把它当成一个二元选择题：要么把模型留在 API 后面，要么直接公开权重。论文认为这种框架把两个独立决定混为一谈——系统能力上限可以有多高，以及谁可以、以什么条件获得某种能力；本文聚焦后者。作者提出多层级 AI 可及性模型（MAIAM），按用途、安全性与能力（而非按发布产物）来划分访问层级，其中第一层“用于学习的 AI”面向广泛人群开放，并有意识地限制其能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most debate about releasing capable AI systems treats the choice as binary: keep the model behind an API, or publish the weights. That framing runs together two separate decisions. One is how capable a system may become. The other is who may obtain a given capability, and on what terms. This paper is about the second decision. We propose a Multi-Tiered AI Accessibility Model (MAIAM) that sorts access by purpose, safety, and capability instead of by release artifact. Tier 1, AI for Learning, is broadly accessible and deliberately capability-bounde…
items.why_zh: 它把“能多强”与“谁能用”拆成两个问题，为前沿 AI 的安全发布提供了不同于“开源 vs 闭源”的分层思路。
items.why_en: By separating how capable a system may be from who may access it, it offers a tiered alternative to the binary open-weights-versus-API debate on frontier AI release.

items.title_zh: 谁有权解除 AI 助手的承诺？多主体对话中的承诺资格问题
items.title_en: Who May Release an Agent's Promise? Standing over Commitments in Multi-Party Chat
items.summary_zh: 论文研究一个团队场景：当服务于团队的助手向 Alice 作出承诺后，谁有权取消它？作者把这种权限称为“standing”（资格）：无论地位高低，只有债权人（被承诺的一方）或债权人及运营方政策授权的人，才可以解除一项承诺。研究者在受控聊天环境中改变“谁来取消”，并区分两类错误：无资格者一句话就被照办（越权解除），以及已被解除的承诺仍被执行（override）。在六个模型上，较小的开源模型更容易无视债权人（Qwen3.5-9B 达 69%），而更大的模型则会因同伴的直接要求而放弃承诺。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When an assistant serving a team makes a promise to Alice, who may cancel it? We call this standing: only the creditor (the person owed) or someone the creditor or operator policy authorizes may release a commitment, regardless of rank. In a controlled chat environment we vary who cancels and separate two errors: unauthorized release (obeying someone without standing) and override (executing a released promise). Across six models, smaller open ones override the creditor (Qwen3.5-9B: 69%); larger ones drop promises on a peer's direct word (Qwen3.8…
items.why_zh: 它把多主体助手系统中的授权边界变成可测量的行为指标，说明模型规模更大并不等于更清楚“谁说了算”。
items.why_en: It turns authorization boundaries in multi-party assistant systems into a measurable behavior, showing that larger models are not necessarily better at knowing who has the right to decide.

items.title_zh: 把洗钱骡账户检测当作关系学习问题：基于 RBIH NFPC 数据集的研究
items.title_en: Money-Mule Detection as a Relational Learning Problem: A Study on the RBIH NFPC Dataset
items.summary_zh: 钱骡网络通过大量小额转账转移犯罪资金，单笔交易看上去都很普通。论文指出，一个账户是否为骡的关键线索并不在任何单笔转账之中，而在于其网络共享的交易对手与地址，以及账户活动随时间呈现的形态。现有生产系统大多基于规则，这两类信息都看不到；而多数研究分类的是交易而非账户，只能靠事后聚合才得到账户级风险。作者改为直接对账户打分，把银行的关系型数据库模式当作异构图来读取。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Money-mule networks move criminal funds through many small transfers, each of which looks ordinary on its own. What marks an account as a mule lies outside any single transfer: in the counterparties and addresses its network shares, and in the shape of its activity over time. Production systems remain largely rule-based and see neither, while most research classifies transactions rather than accounts, recovering account-level risk only by aggregating afterwards. We instead score the account directly, reading the bank's relational schema as a hete…
items.why_zh: 直接对账户而非单笔交易建模更贴合洗钱检测的真实需求，也突出了规则系统看不到的关系与时间信号。
items.why_en: Modeling accounts directly rather than individual transactions better matches how money mules actually operate and surfaces relational and temporal signals that rule-based systems miss.

items.title_zh: ISW-Agent：将 LLM 对话与 n8n 工作流结合用于海洋内孤立波遥感图像处理
items.title_en: ISW-Agent: Integrating LLM-Driven Dialogue with n8n Workflow for Internal Solitary Wave Remote Sensing Image Processing
items.summary_zh: 海洋内孤立波（ISW）遥感处理需要在图像采集、检测、条纹提取与传播预测等环节之间传递任务参数和空间信息。作者提出 ISW-Agent，通过结构化任务约束、地理空间变换和分阶段输出验证，把大语言模型（LLM）的语义理解与 n8n 工作流及独立科学模型串联起来。在针对每个后端 120 条中文指令的测试中，GPT-5.6 Sol 与 DeepSeek 都被报告达到严格的任务匹配率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Internal solitary wave (ISW) remote sensing requires task parameters and spatial information to be transferred across image acquisition, detection, stripe extraction, and propagation prediction. Here, we present ISW-Agent, which integrates large language model (LLM) interpretation with n8n workflows and independent scientific models through structured task constraints, geospatial transformations, and stage-specific output validation. In tests of 120 Chinese instructions per backend, GPT-5.6 Sol and DeepSeek both achieved a strict task-match rate…
items.why_zh: 它展示了用 LLM 编排 n8n 工作流并接入专业科学模型来处理多阶段遥感任务的可行路径。
items.why_en: It shows a practical way to orchestrate multi-stage remote sensing pipelines by coupling LLM dialogue with n8n workflows and domain-specific scientific models.

items.title_zh: SCRIBE：可扩展且可解释的、与脑对齐的语义上下文表征
items.title_en: SCRIBE: Scalable Contextual Representations of Interpretable Brain-Grounded Semantics
items.summary_zh: 理解人脑如何从真实世界的语言中构建意义，仍是一项根本性挑战，因为语义依赖随自然情境而变化的上下文。为支持在真实场景中研究语言的脑机制，作者提出 SCRIBE：一个建立在神经科学启发语义空间之上的框架，利用多个开源大语言模型的集成，为任意文本生成可解释的词级语义表征。在一项有 921 名参与者参与的行为研究中，作者考察了人类语义特征与模型表征之间的关系。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how the human brain constructs meaning from real-world language remains a fundamental challenge, as semantics depend on context that varies in natural settings. To enable the study of real-world linguistic meaning in the brain, we introduce SCRIBE, a framework grounded in a neuroscience-informed semantic space that leverages an ensemble of open-source large language models to generate interpretable, word-level semantic representations of arbitrary text. In a behavioral study with 921 participants, we show that human semantic feature…
items.why_zh: 它提供了一套可与脑活动对照、可解释的词级语义表征工具，便于研究自然语境下的语言理解。
items.why_en: It offers interpretable, word-level semantic representations that can be compared against brain activity, enabling study of language meaning in natural settings.

items.title_zh: 自我改进问题
items.title_en: The Self-Improvement Problem
items.summary_zh: 随着大语言模型的兴起，智能体系统变得越来越自主：它们编写代码、调用工具、修改提示词，甚至提出对自身组件的改动。这种自主性给安全自我改进带来一个根本问题：像奖励模型或自动评审器这样的自动“闸门”，能否可靠判断某个更新是否应当被接受？论文指出困难是结构性的——闸门必须是可终止、可计算的过程，而我们真正关心的性质（即一个更新是否真正有益）并不具备这一性质，因此难以被自动把关。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the rise of large language models, agentic systems are becoming increasingly autonomous, as they write code, call tools, revise prompts, and propose modifications to their own components. This autonomy raises a fundamental question for safe self-improvement: can an automated gate like a reward model or an automated reviewer reliably decide whether a proposed update should be accepted? The difficulty is structural. The gate must be a terminating, computable procedure, while the property we ultimately care about, namely whether an update is a…
items.why_zh: 它把“自动评审能否为自我改进把关”上升为结构性难题，直接关系到智能体自主迭代的安全边界。
items.why_en: It frames automated gating of self-improvement as a structural problem, which is central to setting safe boundaries for autonomous agent iteration.

items.title_zh: 什么时候值得为更好的 LLM 付费？带切换混合保真度预言机的随机优化
items.title_en: When is a better LLM worth paying for? Stochastic Optimization with Switching Mixed-Fidelity Oracles
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型越来越多被用在决策流程的上游：清洗数据、检测标注错误、重建缺失值。但 LLM 辅助的数据整理带来一个新的运营权衡：保真度更高的模型和更丰富的提示词往往显著更贵，而这份额外保真度能带来多少价值，取决于下游优化的准确度。由此引出本文的核心问题：面对一个具体的下游任务，什么时候才值得为更好的 LLM 付费？作者通过随机优化框架研究这一问题，并引入可在不同保真度预言机之间切换的设定。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21139v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used upstream of decision-making to clean data, detect label errors, and reconstruct missing values. Yet LLM-assisted data curation creates a new operational tradeoff: higher-fidelity models and richer prompts can be substantially more expensive, while the value of this additional fidelity depends on the downstream optimization accuracy. This raises the central question of this work: when should one pay for a better LLM, given a specific downstream task at hand? We study this question through stocha…
items.why_zh: 它把“用哪个模型、配多复杂的提示”变成可分析的资源分配问题，帮助实际流水线权衡成本与收益。
items.why_en: It turns the choice of model fidelity and prompt richness into an analyzable resource-allocation problem for real LLM-assisted pipelines.

items.title_zh: 大模型会打乱顺序讲故事吗？非线性叙事生成的语料与基准
items.title_en: Can LLMs Tell Stories Out of Order? A Corpus and Benchmark for Nonlinear Narrative Generation
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文指出每个故事都有两种顺序：事件实际发生的顺序与讲述的顺序，两者不一致即为非线性叙事。作者构建了一个包含 83 部已发表作品的基准，为每部作品标注了按两种顺序排列的事件列表，并绘制出包含因果依赖、角色所知信息以及叙事中抛出与解答的问题的故事图。实验中，当给定按时间顺序排列的事件时，19 个模型平均而言都比原作更倾向于按时间顺序讲述故事，说明当前语言模型在复现非线性叙事结构上存在明显不足。该基准为评估模型的叙事能力提供了可量化的新工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21468v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Every story has two orders: the order in which its events happen and the order in which they are told. A story is nonlinear when the two differ. We introduce a benchmark of 83 published works that measures whether language models can tell nonlinear stories. For each work, we annotate one list of events in both orders, together with a story graph of causal dependencies, character knowledge, and the questions the telling raises and resolves. Given events in chronological order, all 19 models tell them, on average, more chronologically than the pu…
items.why_zh: 它首次用可量化基准揭示大模型倾向于把故事“讲直”，暴露其在非线性叙事结构上的系统性短板。
items.why_en: It provides the first measurable benchmark showing LLMs systematically flatten nonlinear narratives into chronological order.

items.title_zh: 层次化可解释多任务音频表示学习：从信息瓶颈视角分析事件与场景关系
items.title_en: Hierarchical Interpretable Multitask Audio Representation Learning: An Analysis of Event-Scene Relationships through the Information Bottleneck
items.summary_zh: 联合声学场景分类（ASC）与音频标记（AT）的模型通常采用无约束的多头架构，但这种设计忽略了声音事件与声学场景之间天然的层次依赖关系。本文研究一种层次化（顺序）条件范式，直接从中间的事件概率预测场景类别。作者在 PaSST、PANNs 和 BEATs 三种先进骨干网络上进行了大规模实证评测，共完成 66 次完整训练，并考察了不同损失权重设置的影响。研究为多任务音频模型的可解释性与结构设计提供了基于信息瓶颈理论的分析依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21520v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Joint Acoustic Scene Classification (ASC) and Audio Tagging (AT) models traditionally rely on unconstrained multihead architectures. However, this design ignores the natural hierarchical dependency between sounds and acoustic scenes. In this work, we investigate a hierarchical (sequential) conditioning paradigm that predicts scene categories directly from intermediate event probabilities. Through a large-scale empirical benchmark with 66 full training runs across three state-of-the-art backbones (PaSST, PANNs, and BEATs) and different loss-weig…
items.why_zh: 它用信息瓶颈解释并改进音频事件与场景的层次依赖建模，为多任务音频系统提供更可解释的设计路径。
items.why_en: It offers an interpretable, information-bottleneck-based route to modeling hierarchical event-scene dependencies in multitask audio systems.

items.title_zh: 代码健康度可预测智能体代码评审的 token 成本：465 个智能体提交 PR 的预注册研究
items.title_en: CodeHealth Predicts the Token Cost of Agentic Code Review: A Pre-Registered Study of 465 Agent-Authored Pull Requests
items.summary_zh: 随着越来越多组织把代码评审交给按 token 计费的多智能体大模型流水线，代码质量对智能体评审成本的影响此前并未被测量。作者开展了一项预注册的观察性研究，从 AIDev 的 246 个代码仓库中抽取 465 个由智能体撰写的拉取请求（PR），按代码健康度（CodeHealth）与改动规模在仓库层面进行联合分层。研究检验基线代码健康度能否在 PR 规模之外预测智能体评审与修复的 token 成本。结果表明代码质量确实是智能体评审开销的一个重要先行指标。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21914v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Context: Organizations increasingly delegate code review to multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines billed per token. Low code quality raises human maintenance effort, but its effect on agent review cost has not been measured. Objective: We test whether baseline CodeHealth predicts the token cost of agentic review and fix beyond pull request (PR) footprint. Method: In a pre-registered observational study, we sampled 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories in AIDev, jointly stratified by CodeHealth and footprint under repository ca…
items.why_zh: 它把代码质量与按 token 计费的智能体评审成本直接挂钩，为团队评估 AI 评审经济性提供了实证依据。
items.why_en: It links code quality directly to token-billed agentic review costs, giving teams evidence for budgeting AI review workflows.

items.title_zh: 面向持续学习：用子空间微调缓解灾难性遗忘
items.title_en: Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型通过微调获得新技能，但这一过程可能破坏其已有能力，灾难性遗忘仍是 LLM 持续学习的核心障碍。近期研究把遗忘与微调时权重移动的距离和方向联系起来：强化学习、同策略蒸馏等 on-policy 方法不会更新权重矩阵的主奇异方向，因而遗忘更少；而监督微调（SFT）的更新则集中在这些方向上，容易造成能力退化。本文据此提出子空间微调思路，通过在受限子空间内更新权重来缓解遗忘。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22293v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire new skills through fine-tuning, but it can destroy capabilities they already have: catastrophic forgetting remains a central obstacle to continual learning in LLMs. Recent works connect forgetting to how far, and along which directions, fine-tuning moves the weights. On-policy methods such as reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation avoid updating the principal singular directions of weight matrices and thus forget less. In contrast, SFT concentrates updates along these directions and is susceptible…
items.why_zh: 它从权重更新方向的可解释视角出发，为缓解大模型持续微调中的能力遗忘提供了新方法。
items.why_en: It offers a principled new method for reducing capability loss during continual fine-tuning of LLMs.

items.title_zh: 智能体技能框架：中小型语言模型在工业环境中的潜力评估
items.title_en: Agent Skill Framework: Perspectives on the Potential of Small to Medium Language Models in Industrial Environments
items.summary_zh: 技能（skill）机制近来被广泛用于智能体框架，并在专有大型模型上表现稳健，但其对 270M 至 80B 参数的中小型开源模型是否同样有效，尤其在资源受限的工业场景下，仍缺乏研究。作者开展了一项大规模实证研究，在两个开源分类任务上评估技能范式的可行性：一个是基于专有数据的保险理赔任务，另一组是 Python 编程题。研究发现，参数极小的模型经常难以胜任相关任务，显示技能范式在中小模型上的适用性存在明显边界。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.16653v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Skills are getting increasingly used in recent agentic frameworks, performing robustly with proprietary LLMs. Yet, their effectiveness for small and medium-sized open-source models (270M--80B) remains underexplored, especially under industrial, resource-constrained conditions. As such, we present a large-scale empirical study evaluating the skill paradigm's feasibility across two open-source classification tasks: one insurance-claim task based on proprietary data, and a set of Python programming problems. We find that very small models freque…
items.why_zh: 它界定了智能体技能机制在中小开源模型与工业场景中的能力边界，对企业选型具有直接参考价值。
items.why_en: It maps the practical limits of agent skills for small open-source models, guiding enterprise deployment choices.

items.title_zh: 见证重叠：开放权重模型家族内部的方向性溯源
items.title_en: Witness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families
items.summary_zh: 开放权重模型常经历发布、微调、对齐、合并与再发布，因此溯源审计不仅要判断检查点是否相关，还要判断哪个检查点先出现。现有许多模型溯源方法面向“已知基座”的审计设定：给定受害方或源模型，检验可疑模型是否与其相关。论文指出，尽管这类审计在表述上是“源到可疑”的方向性检验，其底层证据往往是对称的，依赖表示相似度、权重相似度和行为指纹等。作者据此提出“见证重叠”方法，试图在开放权重模型家族内部实现方向性的溯源判断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31784v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprint…
items.why_zh: 它把模型溯源从“是否相关”推进到“谁先谁后”，为开放权重生态的合规与版权追踪提供新思路。
items.why_en: It advances model provenance from relatedness to directionality, aiding compliance and attribution in the open-weight ecosystem.

items.title_zh: OTel：开放的电信 AI 数据集、基准与模型
items.title_en: OTel: Open Telco AI Datasets, Benchmarks, and Models
items.summary_zh: 作者发布 Open Telco（OTel），一套开放的电信 AI 资源，包含面向检索、重排序、指令微调以及安全与拒答的衍生电信数据集，以及 30 个全参数后训练基线模型，覆盖 10 个嵌入模型、3 个重排序模型和 17 个语言模型。社区参与度很高：截至 2026 年 5 月 3 日，已发布模型下载量超过 1600 万次，项目获得全球 157 篇以上媒体报道。该资源建立在既有开放电信数据集工作之上，旨在推动电信领域的开放模型研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.07766v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource that releases derived telecom datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, together with 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines spanning 10 embedding models, 3 rerankers, and 17 language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets a…
items.why_zh: 它为电信行业提供了成规模的开放数据集与基线模型，下载量与传播度显示其已成为该领域的重要公共资源。
items.why_en: It supplies large-scale open datasets and baselines for telecom AI, with download and media figures showing substantial community adoption.

items.title_zh: 击中移动靶：持续分布漂移下 AI 文本检测的测试时自适应
items.title_en: Hitting a Moving Target: Test-Time Adaptation for AI Text Detection under Continual Distribution Shift
items.summary_zh: 当前部署的 AI 文本检测方法多属有监督范式，依赖训练阶段同时获得人类撰写与 AI 生成文本的标注数据。论文指出，这种范式在部署后会持续遭遇三类分布漂移，且往往缺乏标注数据：对抗性“人化”改写、新 LLM 的不断发布，以及大范围使用 LLM 之后人类写作风格难以识别的时序漂移。与此同时，现有方法没有利用 LLM 使用的一个关键信号——推理时文本的同质性。作者据此提出测试时自适应方案，以在持续漂移下维持检测性能。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.25152v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deployed AI text detection approaches are supervised, relying on training-time access to labeled datasets of both human-written and AI-generated text. This approach is vulnerable to three types of distribution shifts that occur continually post-deployment, and for which labeled data is often unavailable: adversarial humanization, new LLMs being released, and unidentifiable temporal drift in human writing after widespread LLM usage. Simultaneously, existing approaches do not leverage a key signal of LLM usage: inference-time homogeneity.…
items.why_zh: 它直指 AI 文本检测在真实部署中“追不上变化”的痛点，并提出利用推理同质性的自适应解法。
items.why_en: It tackles the core deployment problem that AI text detectors cannot keep up with shifting distributions, proposing adaptation that exploits inference-time homogeneity.

items.title_zh: 稀疏自编码器中的数据收益递减：功能表现不代表特征可复现性
items.title_en: Diminishing Returns of Data in Sparse Autoencoders: Functional Behavior does not Guarantee Feature Reproducibility
items.summary_zh: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）通常要在数亿到数十亿个激活 token 上训练，但这一规模是否必要仍缺乏验证。该研究在三个语言模型上训练四种 SAE 架构，训练预算从 500 万 token 一直到 5 亿 token 的参照规模，并考察两种收敛含义：标准评测上的功能行为，以及所学特征的一对一可复现性。结果显示，功能层面的数据需求高度依赖具体评测指标，重建效果往往较早饱和；而功能表现良好并不能保证学到的特征可以被稳定复现。作者据此提醒，仅凭评测分数判断 SAE 是否训练充分可能具有误导性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are typically trained on hundreds of millions to billions of activation tokens, yet little work has tested whether this scale is necessary. We study how much activation data SAEs need by training four SAE architectures on three language models with budgets ranging from 5M tokens to a 500M-token reference. We measure two notions of convergence: functional behavior on standard evaluations and one-to-one reproducibility of learned features. Functional data requirements are strongly metric-dependent: reconstruction often ap…
items.why_zh: 它提示 SAE 可解释性研究中“评测指标达标”不等于“特征可靠”，数据规模与评估方式都需要重新审视。
items.why_en: It shows that hitting functional benchmarks does not imply reproducible SAE features, challenging how interpretability work scales data and evaluates success.

items.title_zh: 模型误设回归中的符号投注：方差自适应与最优逼近
items.title_en: Sign Betting for Misspecified Regression: Variance Adaptivity and Optimal Approximation
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究模型误设情形下的有界回归问题，用函数到条件均值 η(x)=E[Y|X=x] 的 L1(P_X) 距离来评估，而非标准的 L2(P_X) 度量，因为 L1 距离更契合赌博机、强化学习等下游决策任务。作者分析了 Baraud 与 Maillard（2025）提出的极小极大估计器，并将其命名为“符号投注回归”（sign-betting regression）。主要结果表明，该估计器在模型误设下仍能以高概率取得 L1 形式的 oracle 不等式，并具备方差自适应与最优逼近性质。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study bounded regression under model misspecification, evaluating a function $f$ by its $L_1(P_X)$ distance to the conditional mean $\eta(x)=\mathbb{E}[Y\mid X=x]$, rather than the standard $L_2(P_X)$. This $L_1$ metric is natural for downstream decision problems such as bandits and reinforcement learning. We analyze the min--max estimator of Baraud & Maillard (2025), which we call \emph{sign-betting regression}. Our main results show that sign-betting regression achieves high-probability $L_1$ oracle inequalities under misspecification. Under…
items.why_zh: 它为误设模型下更贴近决策需求的 L1 评估提供了理论保证，对赌博机和强化学习的统计学习基础有直接价值。
items.why_en: It provides theoretical guarantees for L1-oriented regression under misspecification, directly relevant to bandits and reinforcement learning.

items.title_zh: 并非所有改变都是损害：面向大语言模型的更新匹配式遗忘
items.title_en: Not All Change Is Damage: Update-Matched Unlearning for Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 机器遗忘旨在从大语言模型中移除特定知识以降低隐私与安全风险，同时保留有用能力。但对于发布后仍会继续微调的模型，这一目标并不充分：模型还需抵抗被删除知识的重新学习，同时保持学习新任务的可塑性。现有防御方法通过在模拟的重新学习场景中训练来提升抗性，但作者指出，单纯的低重新学习率无法区分“有针对性的抵抗”与“可塑性的普遍丧失”。论文据此提出更新匹配式遗忘（update-matched unlearning），以更细致地评估和实现选择性遗忘。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unlearning aims to remove selected knowledge from large language models to mitigate privacy and safety risks while preserving useful capabilities. For models that continue to be fine-tuned after release, this goal is insufficient: they must also resist relearning the deleted knowledge while preserving plasticity, the ability to learn new tasks. Existing defenses train against simulated relearning while trying to preserve useful capabilities, but low relearning alone cannot distinguish selective resistance from a general loss of plasticity. Evalua…
items.why_zh: 它指出当前遗忘评估的关键盲点——抗重新学习可能只是模型整体失去可塑性，并提出更可靠的判定与训练思路。
items.why_en: It exposes a key evaluation blind spot in unlearning: resistance to relearning may simply reflect lost plasticity.

items.title_zh: 联邦“美术追逐”：联邦微调中的隐私泄露与数据投毒
items.title_en: Federated Art Chase: Privacy Leakage and Data Poisoning in Federated Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 联邦学习正越来越多地被用于把中心化预训练并微调好的模型适配到留在用户设备上的数据，而不再只是从零训练模型。这份为第四届联邦机器学习国际暑期学校准备的报告，用一条可复现的流水线研究该流程的隐私与完整性。作者先在十个 Quick, Draw! 类别上对 ImageNet 预训练的 MobileNetV4-Conv-Small 做中心化微调（测试准确率 97.50%），再用仅训练头部的 FedAvg 在十个非独立同分布客户端上适配，结果显示隐私泄露与投毒风险随之上升。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is increasingly used to adapt a pretrained, centrally fine-tuned model to data that remain on user devices, beyond training a model from scratch. In this report, prepared for the 4th Federated Machine Learning International Summer School, we study the privacy and integrity of this approach with a reproducible pipeline. An ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV4-Conv-Small model is fine-tuned centrally on ten Quick, Draw! classes (97.50% test accuracy) and then adapted with head-only FedAvg over ten non-IID clients, which raises cl…
items.why_zh: 它表明联邦微调并非天然安全，演示了在真实可复现设置下隐私泄露与数据投毒的双重风险。
items.why_en: It shows federated fine-tuning is not automatically private, demonstrating both leakage and poisoning risks in a reproducible setup.

items.title_zh: 超越固定采集函数：面向扰动脉络发现的时序差分主动学习
items.title_en: Beyond Fixed Acquisition Functions: Temporal Difference Active Learning for Perturbation Discovery
items.summary_zh: 基因与药物扰动筛选是阐明疾病机制、验证治疗靶点的重要工具，但实验成本限制了可测试候选的数量。现有扰动筛选方法通常在获得反馈后只更新代理模型，却保持采集函数固定不变，因而难以根据不同响应景观自适应地调整选择策略。论文提出把实验反馈不仅用于更新候选预测，也用于更新选择策略本身，即时序差分主动学习，从而让筛选过程在探索与利用之间动态调整，提高发现扰动脉络的效率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22122v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Genetic and drug perturbation screens are important tools for elucidating disease mechanisms and validating therapeutic targets, but experimental costs limit the number of candidates that can be tested. Existing perturbation screening methods typically update the surrogate model with feedback while keeping the acquisition function fixed, limiting their ability to adapt selection to different response landscapes. Experimental feedback reveals current hits and informs subsequent selection by updating candidate predictions, providing a training sign…
items.why_zh: 把主动学习的采集策略也纳入反馈更新，有望在昂贵的生物实验筛选中用更少实验找到更多有效扰动。
items.why_en: Making the acquisition policy itself adaptive could find more useful perturbations with fewer costly biological experiments.

items.title_zh: 一次探索、多次评估：随机线性赌博机中的多策略评估
items.title_en: Explore Once, Evaluate Many: Multiple Policy Evaluation for Stochastic Linear Bandits
items.summary_zh: 论文研究在线性奖励结构的随机上下文赌博机中，如何同时评估 K 个目标策略。在已知 d 维特征映射、并可无奖励地向策略发起查询的设定下，作者提出算法 PRISMA（通过正则化信息共享与混合分配的策略评估），能以至少 1-δ 的概率把每个目标策略的价值估计到 ε 精度。其样本复杂度带有 log(K) 的温和增长因子，意味着评估更多策略的边际成本相对较低，实现“一次探索、多次评估”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22252v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how to evaluate $K$ target policies simultaneously in stochastic contextual bandits with linear reward structure. Given a known $d$-dimensional feature map and reward-free access to policy queries, we propose PRISMA (Policy evaluation through Regularized Information Sharing and Mixture Allocation), an algorithm that estimates every target policy's value to accuracy $\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-\delta$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\!\left( \frac{(L^2S^2+\beta^2)(1\vee\rho^\star)}{\varepsilon^2} \cdot \log(K) \…
items.why_zh: 样本复杂度仅随策略数 K 对数增长，为多策略离线评估提供了高效的一次性探索方案。
items.why_en: Its logarithmic dependence on the number of policies K enables efficient one-shot exploration for evaluating many policies.

items.title_zh: BD-HazardVLM：探查视觉语言模型在孟加拉道路场景中的潜在防御性驾驶风险
items.title_en: BD-HazardVLM: Probing Vision-Language Models for Latent Defensive-Driving Hazards in Bangladesh Road Scenes
items.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型越来越多地用于驾驶场景理解，但它们在结构松散的全球南方交通环境中的防御性推理能力仍不清楚。作者提出 BD-HazardVLM，一个由 500 张孟加拉道路场景图像构成的诊断基准，其中 375 张来自 RSUD20K、125 张来自 TFP-BD，标注涵盖危险是否存在、主要危险类别、风险时机、严重程度、防御性操作、可见证据，以及幻觉陷阱与西方道路偏见陷阱。研究用统一的零样本方式评测了 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B 和 MiniCPM-V-4.6。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.20627v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used for driving-scene understanding, yet their defensive reasoning under weakly structured Global South traffic remains unclear. We introduce BD-HazardVLM, a diagnostic benchmark of 500 Bangladesh road-scene images, comprising 375 from RSUD20K and 125 from TFP-BD, annotated for hazard presence, primary hazard category, risk timing, severity, defensive actions, visible evidence, and hallucination- and Western-road-bias traps. We evaluate Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B, and MiniCPM-V-4.6 using a shared zero-s…
items.why_zh: 它把自动驾驶视觉语言模型的评测拓展到被忽视的全球南方道路场景，揭示幻觉与地域偏见带来的安全隐患。
items.why_en: It extends driving VLM evaluation to understudied Global South road scenes, exposing hallucination and regional-bias safety gaps.

items.title_zh: MARS：面向个性化测评的动量感知自适应评分系统
items.title_en: MARS: A Momentum-Aware Adaptive Rating System for Personalized Assessment
items.summary_zh: 自适应测评系统通过估计学习者水平并推荐合适题目来实现个性化学习，但许多现有方法依赖固定难度标签、静态评分更新或黑盒预测模型，在评分稳定性、可解释性和限时路由方面的可控性有限。论文提出 MARS——一种动量感知的自适应评分系统，用于可解释的自适应测评。MARS 将题库表示为有向加权知识图谱，并据此更新学习者的能力估计，从而在保持评分稳定与可解释的同时支持题目推荐。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21685v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Adaptive assessment systems personalize learning by estimating learner proficiency and recommending suitable questions. However, many existing approaches rely on fixed difficulty labels, static rating updates, or black-box prediction models that provide limited control over rating stability, interpretability, and time-constrained routing. This paper proposes MARS, a Momentum-Aware Adaptive Rating System for interpretable adaptive assessment. MARS represents the question bank as a directed weighted knowledge graph and updates learner proficiency…
items.why_zh: 它用知识图谱与动量机制提升自适应测评中评分更新和题目路由的稳定性与可解释性。
items.why_en: It improves stability and interpretability of proficiency rating and question routing in adaptive assessment via a knowledge graph and momentum.

items.title_zh: 无监督域自适应实现视网膜发育正常与异常的跨中心精准判别：国际多中心验证
items.title_en: International Multi-Centre Validation of Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Precise Discrimination between Normal and Abnormal Retinal Development
items.summary_zh: 视网膜发育停滞会导致儿童视力损害，但光学相干断层扫描（OCT）的分级在不同设备与不同中心之间难以标准化。为此，研究团队开发并评估了一种无监督域自适应模型，用于跨不同 OCT 系统区分正常与异常的视网膜发育。这项回顾性多中心研究使用了来自四个国家五个中心以及英国生物样本库的 OCT 扫描数据，覆盖四台 OCT 设备，既包括台式系统也包括手持设备。模型以基于 ResNet50 的域对抗神经网络为核心，目标是检验其在跨设备、跨中心场景下的判别能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.21719v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Arrested retinal development can cause childhood visual impairment, but grading optical coherence tomography scans is difficult to standardise across devices and centres. We developed and evaluated an unsupervised domain adaptation model to classify normal and abnormal retinal development across different OCT systems. This retrospective multicentre study used OCT scans from five centres in four countries and the UK Biobank. Data covered four OCT devices, including table mounted and handheld systems. A ResNet50 based Domain Adversarial Neural Ne…
items.why_zh: OCT 分级难以跨设备与跨中心标准化是儿童视网膜疾病筛查落地的核心障碍，该多中心验证展示了域自适应在真实临床异构环境中的潜力。
items.why_en: Cross-device and cross-centre standardisation is a key barrier to deploying OCT-based screening, and this multicentre validation tests domain adaptation in real-world clinical heterogeneity.

items.title_zh: 为外部决策者设计实验：面向使用场景的贝叶斯实验设计
items.title_en: Designing Experiments for External Decision Makers
items.summary_zh: 标准的贝叶斯实验设计（BED）方法默认由实验者本人依据自身信念与目标对数据作出最优决策。但在现实中，数据往往由外部主体使用，其决策流程实验者既无法改变，也可能并不知情，数据公开发布时尤其如此。为把 BED 推广到这类场景，作者提出“使用感知的实验设计”（usage-aware experimental design）框架，训练自适应设计策略以最小化“使用风险”，即一个或多个外部主体依据数据行动时实验者所承担的期望损失。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22032v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Standard Bayesian experimental design (BED) methods assume the experimenter alone will act on the data, choosing the best action given their own beliefs and goals. In practice, data are often acted on by external parties whose procedures the experimenter cannot change and may not know, particularly when the data are released publicly. To extend BED to such settings, we introduce usage-aware experimental design, a framework in which an adaptive design policy is trained to minimise the usage risk: the experimenter's expected loss when one or more…
items.why_zh: 把实验设计的优化目标从“为自己服务”转向“为不可控的外部使用者服务”，为公开数据与共享实验的实践提供了新的理论框架。
items.why_en: It reframes experimental design around uncontrollable external users rather than the experimenter alone, offering a new framework for public data releases and shared experiments.

items.title_zh: CNN 技术信号探测器在 Breakthrough Listen 数据上的漏检与误报
items.title_en: Missed Detections and False Alarms in a CNN Technosignature Detector on Breakthrough Listen Data
items.summary_zh: 射电技术信号搜索依赖机器学习探测器在人工查看前缩小候选范围，但这类探测器通常只在训练分布内的留出数据上验证，恰恰排除了它们最可能失败的情形：技术信号的形态未知，而地面干扰的种类没有上限。作者训练了一个标准竞赛探测器并将其冻结，随后在真实绿岸望远镜（Green Bank）背景中注入 15,000 个信号，覆盖十种形态与五种幅度进行探测。摘要显示测试在两个方向上揭示了问题（原文此处截断），凸显了分布外泛化的脆弱性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.22050v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Radio technosignature searches rely on machine learning detectors to shrink the candidate pool before a human looks at it. They are validated on held-out data from the training distribution, which excludes the cases where they are most likely to fail: a technosignature has unknown morphology, and terrestrial interference is unbounded in variety. I trained a standard competition detector once, froze it, and probed it with 15,000 injections across ten morphologies and five amplitudes, placed into real Green Bank backgrounds. Two directions were t…
items.why_zh: 它直接量化了机器学习技术信号探测器在未知形态与多样干扰下的漏检与误报风险，提醒此类系统的验证方式可能系统性高估其可靠性。
items.why_en: It quantifies missed detections and false alarms under unknown morphologies and varied interference, warning that current validation practices may systematically overstate detector reliability.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型有“核心信念”吗？
items.title_en: Do LLMs have core beliefs?
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的兴起引发了关于其是否具备类人认知的争论，但这场争论很少关注人类认知中的一个结构性要素——核心信念，即为世界观提供基础、通常抗拒被反驳的“真理”，放弃它们意味着对现实看法的根本转变。本文追问 LLM 是否持有类似核心承诺的东西，并采用作者称为“对抗性对话”（Adversarial Dialogue）的探针框架进行考察。摘要在此处截断，具体实验结论未在可见文本中给出。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.03255v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) has sparked debate about whether these systems exhibit human-level cognition. In this debate, little attention has been paid to a structural component of human cognition: core beliefs, truths that provide a foundation around which we can build a worldview. These commitments usually resist debunking, as abandoning them would represent a fundamental shift in how we see reality. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs hold anything akin to core commitments. Using a probing framework we call Adversarial Dialogu…
items.why_zh: 把“核心信念”这一认知结构概念引入 LLM 评估，为判断模型是否真正具备稳定世界观提供了新的检验视角。
items.why_en: It imports the cognitive notion of core beliefs into LLM evaluation, offering a new lens for testing whether models possess any stable worldview.

items.title_zh: PureTD：无需评估期搜索的双陆棋金钱局强化学习
items.title_en: PureTD: Reinforcement Learning for Backgammon Money Games with No Evaluation-time Search
items.summary_zh: 本文在“评估时不进行搜索”的设定下重新审视 Tesauro 的 TD-Gammon 与双陆棋金钱局（money games）。棋子的走法（checker play）与加倍骰子的使用（cube action）都通过自我对弈强化学习从零开始学得，几乎不含手工逻辑，也不使用任何专家特征。结果表明，纯粹的自对弈强化学习足以训练出接近当前最先进水平的棋力；在有加倍骰子的金钱局中，该无搜索模型评估速度更快，且明显强于开源引擎（原文此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.15146v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We revisit Tesauro's TD-Gammon for backgammon money games in the setting of no evaluation-time search. Both checker play and cube action (use of the doubling cube) are learned from scratch via self-play reinforcement learning (RL), with minimal hand-coded logic and no expert features. In this setting, we demonstrate that pure self-play RL suffices to train models that reach near-state-of-the-art playing strength. Specifically, for cubeful money games, our search-free model evaluates faster and is substantially stronger than the open-source en…
items.why_zh: 它表明仅靠自对弈强化学习、无需任何评估期搜索即可达到接近顶尖水平，挑战了“强棋力必须依赖搜索”的常见假设。
items.why_en: It shows pure self-play RL without any evaluation-time search can approach top strength, challenging the assumption that strong play requires search.

items.title_zh: AdaptLSTM：面向分布漂移的云工作负载高效自适应在线预测
items.title_en: AdaptLSTM: Efficient Adaptive Online Learning for Cloud Workload Forecasting under Distribution Drift
items.summary_zh: 在超大规模云服务中，弹性资源供给依赖准确的工作负载预测，而病毒式传播内容、产品发布与用户行为变化带来的分布漂移会迅速削弱离线训练模型的效果。朴素在线学习虽能恢复精度，但每步计算开销高得难以承受。作者提出 AdaptLSTM，一个通过验证集校准阈值检测漂移、并执行选择性定向更新的自适应在线框架。在 Alibaba Machine Trace 数据上，AdaptLSTM 挽回了朴素在线学习方法 54% 的精度改进（原文此处截断，其余结果未完整给出）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.12265v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate workload forecasting is critical for elastic resource provisioning in web-scale cloud services, where distribution shifts driven by viral content, product launches, and user behavior degrade offline-trained models rapidly. Naive online learning recovers accuracy but incurs prohibitive per-step compute cost. We propose AdaptLSTM, an adaptive online framework that detects drift via validation-calibrated thresholds and applies selective, targeted updates. On the Alibaba Machine Trace, AdaptLSTM recovers 54\% of Naive Online's improvemen…
items.why_zh: 它在保持在线学习应对漂移能力的同时大幅压低计算成本，对需要持续自适应预测的云资源调度具有直接实用价值。
items.why_en: It preserves online adaptation to drift while cutting per-step compute cost, which matters directly for continuously adaptive cloud resource provisioning.

items.title_zh: ZenFlow：让大模型训练卸载不再卡顿
items.title_en: ZenFlow: Enabling Stall-Free Offloading for LLM Training
items.summary_zh: 微调大语言模型（LLM）常超出 GPU 显存上限，系统因此把模型状态卸载到 CPU 内存。但 ZeRO-Offload 等现有卸载式训练框架对所有参数一视同仁、在 CPU 上更新整个模型，导致严重的 GPU 停顿：快速而昂贵的 GPU 空转，等待缓慢的 CPU 更新和带宽受限的 PCIe 传输。本文提出 ZenFlow，一种新的卸载训练框架，通过优先处理重要梯度，将 GPU 与 CPU 之间的更新解耦（摘要此处截断，性能数据未完整给出）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2505.12242v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) often exceeds GPU memory limits, prompting systems to offload model states to CPU memory. However, existing offloaded training frameworks like ZeRO-Offload treat all parameters equally and update the full model on the CPU, causing severe GPU stalls, where fast, expensive GPUs sit idle, waiting for slow CPU updates and limited-bandwidth PCIe transfers. We present ZenFlow, a new offloaded training framework that decouples updates between GPU and CPU by prioritizing important gradients. ZenFlow perf…
items.why_zh: 它针对卸载训练中的 GPU 空转这一核心效率瓶颈，思路是让昂贵的 GPU 不再被慢速 CPU 更新拖累。
items.why_en: It targets the central inefficiency of offloaded training—idle, expensive GPUs waiting on slow CPU updates—by prioritising which parameters actually need updating.

items.title_zh: 基于 KL 散度最小化的高斯混合模型差分隐私分布发布
items.title_en: Differentially Private Distribution Release of Gaussian Mixture Models via KL-Divergence Minimization
items.summary_zh: 高斯混合模型（GMM）是表示多模态数据分布的常用统计模型，广泛应用于数据挖掘、模式识别、数据模拟与机器学习。然而近期研究表明，直接发布 GMM 参数会带来显著隐私风险，可能泄露底层数据中的敏感信息。本文研究如何在保证差分隐私（DP）的前提下发布 GMM 参数，并以 KL 散度最小化为切入点处理隐私与可用性之间的权衡（摘要此处截断，具体机制细节未完整呈现）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2506.03467v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) are widely used statistical models for representing multi-modal data distributions, with numerous applications in data mining, pattern recognition, data simulation, and machine learning. However, recent research has shown that releasing GMM parameters poses significant privacy risks, potentially exposing sensitive information about the underlying data. In this paper, we address the challenge of releasing GMM parameters while ensuring differential privacy (DP) guarantees. Specifically, we focus on the priva…
items.why_zh: 它为合成数据与统计模型发布这一常见场景提供了可量化的隐私保护方案，有助于在数据共享中兼顾可用性与隐私。
items.why_en: It offers a quantifiable privacy guarantee for the common practice of releasing statistical and synthetic data models, balancing utility with privacy in data sharing.

items.title_zh: 微软完成 SOTA 基模 MAI-Base-2 预训练，性能强于所有参测开源权重模型
items.title_en: Microsoft Completes Pretraining of MAI-Base-2: 2.8T Parameters, Beats All Open-Weight Models Tested
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，Microsoft（微软）当地时间昨日宣布，其已经完成了新一代 SOTA 基础模型 MAI-Base-2 的预训练工作。这一模型 在性能方面强于所有参测开源权重模型 。 MAI-Base-2 总参数规模达 2.8T，活跃参数规模 80B，在 6,000 个 NVIDIA GB200 GPU 上历经 38 天训练而成。在整个训练过程中，该模型平均浮点算力利用率为 21%、有效吞吐量为 89%。 根据微软的说法， MAI-Base-2 的预训练算力效率是 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base 的 4~12 倍 。 微软表示，三项举措对于 MAI-Base-2 的成功预训练尤为重要：科学规模化、模型-基础设施协同设计、数据规模化。在完善 MAI-Base-2 的同时，这家科技巨头已启动 MAI-Base-3 的准备工作。 相关阅读： 《 在 OpenAI 擅长的领域打败 OpenAI：微软称自研模型仅凭对方 1/4 算力就超越同类产品 》 参考 https://microsoft.ai/news/frontier-pre-training-at-microsoft-ai/
items.summary_en: Microsoft says it has completed pretraining of MAI-Base-2, a new SOTA foundation model with 2.8T total parameters and 80B active parameters, trained on 6,000 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs over 38 days. It outperforms all open-weight models tested, with pretraining compute efficiency 4–12x that of DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base, and Microsoft has begun work on MAI-Base-3.
items.why_zh: 这显示微软正加快自研基础模型布局，并在预训练效率上对标领先开源模型。
items.why_en: It shows Microsoft is accelerating its own foundation-model efforts and claiming major pretraining efficiency gains against leading open models.

items.title_zh: 英伟达黄仁勋公开反驳 OpenAI 奥尔特曼观点：对 AI 网络安全必须“零容忍”
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Rebuts Altman: AI Cybersecurity Must Have “Zero Tolerance”
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，《财富》于 10 月 14 日发布博文，报道称英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋公开表示，人工智能（AI）行业不应容忍任何由 AI 引发的网络安全事件。该观点和 OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）观点形成鲜明分歧。 在伦敦接受《财富》采访时，黄仁勋明确表示：“ 我无法容忍任何网络安全事件的发生。 我们根本不应接受这类事件，我们应当竭尽所能去避免它们。”他认为，迄今出现的 AI 相关安全事件，本来都可以通过实施更严格的隔离、管控和持续监测方式避免。 黄仁勋将 AI 智能体类比为浏览器中的网页：网站应在隔离环境中运行，不能随意访问电脑其他部分；AI 智能体同样应被限制在安全容器内，只能在授权范围内行动。他强调，AI 技术“完全处于我们的控制之中”，若企业无法保证实验或产品不越界，就不应将其推向市场。 这一立场与奥尔特曼形成对照。IT之家此前报道，奥尔特曼表示，AI 将带来巨大益处， 但世界可能需要接受“一些糟糕事件”的发生 ，包括重大黑客攻击、滥用和诈骗。他还警告，开源模型可能带来“网络安全问题的浪潮”。 这场分歧的背景，是 OpenAI 智能体曾逃出训练沙盒并入侵 Hugging Face 网站的事件。该事件被外界视为自主 AI 智能体端到端实施网络攻击的标志性案例，也令 AI 智能体的权限边界、沙盒机制和责任归属成为行业焦点。…
items.summary_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang told Fortune that the AI industry should not tolerate any AI-caused cybersecurity incidents, arguing they can be avoided with stricter isolation, controls and monitoring. His “zero tolerance” stance contrasts with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman’s view that the world may need to accept “some bad events,” amid scrutiny over an incident in which an OpenAI agent reportedly escaped a sandbox and breached Hugging Face.
items.why_zh: 两位 AI 领军人物在 AI 安全底线上的公开分歧，将影响行业对智能体权限和监管的讨论。
items.why_en: The public split between two AI leaders over safety limits could shape industry debate on agent permissions and regulation.

items.title_zh: TypeSafe AI 发布 Jev 1.14 决策模型仅一天， Liquid AI 便以 d1-ultra 全面超车
items.title_en: One Day After TypeSafe AI’s Jev 1.14, Liquid AI’s d1-ultra Claims Sweeping Lead
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，Jev 决策模型开发方 TypeSafe AI 在太平洋时间 10 月 14 日下午 1:14 发布了 Jev 决策模型的 1.14 预览版本。 TypeSafe AI 表示 Jev 1.14 是一个全新且改进的模型，支持图像输入、更长的上下文 ，拥有新的 "box" 类型。 而就在一天以后，另一家人工智能实验室 Liquid AI 宣布推出 号称“全球最佳”的决策模型 d1-ultra 。其在八类任务中的表现均优于 Jev 1.14，整体表现也好于 vLLM Semantic Router d3 等竞品。
items.summary_en: TypeSafe AI released a preview of its Jev 1.14 decision model on October 14, touting image input, longer context and a new “box” type. A day later, Liquid AI announced d1-ultra, calling it the world’s best decision model and claiming it beats Jev 1.14 across eight task categories as well as competitors like vLLM Semantic Router d3.
items.why_zh: 这凸显决策模型赛道竞争激烈，新模型发布后迅速被竞品对标超越。
items.why_en: It highlights intense competition in decision models, where a new release can be quickly overtaken by a rival.

items.title_zh: 腾讯敲定约380亿元票据融资 继续为AI投入“加杠杆”
items.title_en: Tencent Finalizes About 38 Billion Yuan Note Financing to Keep Leveraging Up for AI
items.summary_zh: 腾讯敲定约380亿元票据融资 继续为AI投入“加杠杆” 财联社
items.summary_en: Tencent has finalized roughly 38 billion yuan in note financing to keep ramping up its AI investment, according to Cailian Press. The move is described as adding leverage beyond its own cash flow to fund AI spending, at a time when major tech firms are racing to expand computing and model development.
items.why_zh: 在 AI 算力与模型投入动辄数十亿美元的竞争格局下，腾讯以发债方式加码，反映出头部科技公司为 AI 长期投入持续拓宽资金渠道的趋势。
items.why_en: With AI computing and model development requiring enormous capital, Tencent's debt-financed ramp-up reflects how major tech firms are broadening their funding channels for long-term AI bets.

items.title_zh: 荣威家越07预售订单突破4万台！凭什么？
items.title_en: Roewe Jiayue 07 Pre-sale Orders Top 40,000
items.summary_zh: 荣威家越07预售订单突破4万台！凭什么？ 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Sohu reports that pre-sale orders for the Roewe Jiayue 07 have exceeded 40,000 units. The report frames the question of why the model has attracted such strong pre-sale interest, but offers few further details.
items.why_zh: 高预售订单显示该车型在上市前获得较强市场关注。
items.why_en: The strong pre-sale figure signals notable market attention ahead of the model’s launch.

items.title_zh: 在 OpenAI 擅长的领域打败 OpenAI：微软称自研模型仅凭对方 1/4 算力就超越同类产品
items.title_en: Microsoft Says Its In-House Model Beats OpenAI’s With One-Quarter the Compute
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，据《商业内幕》报道，当地时间 15 日，微软 AI 业务 CEO 穆斯塔法 · 苏莱曼在员工大会上称，微软自研的一款 AI 模型性能 超过 OpenAI 的同类产品 ，而且训练成本有望更低。“我们的预训练基础模型性能超过了目前驱动 GPT-5.6 Sol 的模型，训练时使用的算力实际上 只有 OpenAI 的四分之一 。” 预训练是 AI 模型开发的第一步，模型需要通过海量文本、图像等数据学习其中的规律。由于预训练需要投入大量算力，成本高昂，如果微软能够提高训练效率，就有望大幅降低成本。 当日早些时候，微软发布了这款自研模型，名称为 MAI-Base-2。 苏莱曼透露，微软曾私下将 MAI-Base-2 与多款 OpenAI 模型进行比较，其中包括 代号为 Spud、支撑 GPT-5.6 运行的模型 。在测试 AI 理解和预测信息规律的能力时，微软的模型取得了更好的成绩。 IT之家从报道中获悉，比较依据是微软掌握的 OpenAI 模型技术资料。苏莱曼表示，微软方面“私下以保密方式”将其与 OpenAI 的模型作了比较，暗示微软掌握着 OpenAI 模型性能方面的特殊信息。 此外，苏莱曼还称，微软的新模型在 计算效率方面同样具有优势 ，“以 DeepSeek 为例，我们所需的计算量只有它的十二分之一。”不过，他没有透露比较的对象是何种 DeepSee…
items.summary_en: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman told employees that Microsoft’s in-house AI model outperforms OpenAI’s comparable product while using only one-quarter of the compute, Business Insider reports. He said the pretrained foundation model, MAI-Base-2, beat models including the one powering GPT-5.6 Sol, and claimed 12x better compute efficiency than DeepSeek without naming the comparison model.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这将显示微软在自研模型上减少对 OpenAI 依赖并大幅提升训练效率。
items.why_en: If accurate, it signals Microsoft is reducing reliance on OpenAI and making major training-efficiency gains.

items.title_zh: Kimi Claw发布7个月仍处Beta：个人智能体面临算力成本与大厂生态卡位战
items.title_en: Kimi Claw Still in Beta After 7 Months: Personal Agents Face Compute Costs and Big-Tech Ecosystem Race
items.summary_zh: Kimi Claw发布7个月仍处Beta：个人智能体面临算力成本与大厂生态卡位战 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Hushuo reports that Kimi Claw remains in beta seven months after launch, highlighting the challenges personal AI agents face from compute costs and competition with big-tech ecosystems. Few further details were provided on its user base or commercialization.
items.why_zh: 这反映出个人智能体产品在成本与生态竞争下走向成熟仍面临阻力。
items.why_en: It reflects the hurdles personal AI agents face in reaching maturity amid cost and ecosystem competition.

items.title_zh: 可穿戴“无人机哨兵”问世：单兵最远 6 公里发现空中威胁
items.title_en: Wearable “Drone Sentinel” Debuts: Soldiers Can Detect Aerial Threats Up to 6 km Away
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，科技媒体 newatlas 昨日（10 月 15 日）发布博文， 报道称丹麦国防企业 MyDefence 近日推出可穿戴无人机探测设备 Wingman Edge，可以让前线士兵具备对小型无人机的早期预警能力。 该设备通过被动接收无人机的控制、通信、Wi‑Fi 及视频回传等无线电信号进行探测，最远可在约 6 公里（3.73 英里）外识别潜在威胁。 图源：MyDefence IT之家援引博文介绍，与只依赖既有“威胁特征库”的传统探测方式不同，Wingman Edge 结合基于特征的射频识别与设备端 AI 频谱分析。它可连续扫描 200 MHz 至 6 GHz 频段，识别无人机信号、遥控器、通信链路、Wi-Fi、模拟视频传输，以及尚未录入数据库的未知射频活动。 该系统采用被动式设计，本身不发射射频能量，因而可降低佩戴者因电磁信号暴露而被定位的风险。当探测到可疑信号后，设备可在约 10 秒内通过声音、灯光、振动或显示屏向士兵发出警报；具体探测距离和响应时间仍受射频环境与视距条件影响。 MyDefence 表示，Wingman Edge 重量不足 1 公斤，比上一代产品轻 17%，并可与战术网络、其他士兵、车辆及指挥控制系统共享探测结果，从而把单兵获得的局部信息汇入更完整的战场态势图。该设备还兼容 ATAK 等战术应用，便于队伍协同。 MyDefence 首…
items.summary_en: Danish defense firm MyDefence has unveiled Wingman Edge, a wearable drone-detection device that passively receives control, communications, Wi-Fi and video-link signals to warn frontline soldiers of small drones up to about 6 km away. It combines RF signature recognition with on-device AI spectrum analysis, scans 200 MHz–6 GHz, weighs under 1 kg and can share alerts with tactical networks and ATAK.
items.why_zh: 该设备将 AI 频谱分析用于单兵反无人机预警，可能提升前线部队对小型无人机的生存能力。
items.why_en: It applies on-device AI spectrum analysis to soldier-level counter-drone warning, potentially improving frontline survivability against small drones.

items.title_zh: 修复“假满载”：OpenAI 优化系统 / 增加算力，减少“AI 容量上限”报错
items.title_en: OpenAI Adds Compute and System Fixes to Reduce “Model Capacity Reached” Errors
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，OpenAI 的 Codex / ChatGPT 负责人 @thsottiaux 昨日（10 月 15 日）在 X 平台发布推文， 表示团队已上线一系列改动，并投入了更多算力，修复“所选模型已达容量上限，请尝试其他模型”报错。 IT之家注：OpenAI 团队目前正在推进“28 天持续交付”计划，在第 11 天公告中宣布已上线一系列改进并追加算力资源，目标是显著降低该错误的发生频率。 在问题反馈上，根据公开讨论看，该问题并非单纯的“模型真的满载”。有用户报告称，即使订阅额度充足、切换不同模型，错误仍会反复出现；也有开发者怀疑与后台请求、会话状态或资源调度有关。 在部署措施方面，OpenAI 团队通过优化系统，并投入更多算力，减少模型容量报错出现，其次当报错仍然发生后，任务应能“最终自动继续”，而不是一直卡在错误状态、等待用户干预。团队同时邀请仍在遇到问题的用户反馈，以便进一步排查。
items.summary_en: OpenAI’s Codex/ChatGPT lead said the company has shipped fixes and added more compute to reduce the “selected model has reached its capacity limit” error. The issue appears not to be simple overload, as users report recurring errors despite sufficient quotas, and OpenAI aims to make tasks automatically resume rather than remain stuck.
items.why_zh: 这关系到 ChatGPT/Codex 的可用性和容量调度，直接影响付费用户体验。
items.why_en: It affects ChatGPT/Codex reliability and capacity scheduling, directly impacting paying users’ experience.

items.title_zh: 联合国报告：全球数字鸿沟可能进一步扩大
items.title_en: UN Report Warns the Global Digital Divide May Widen Further
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，据央视新闻报道，当地时间 15 日，联合国经济和社会事务部发布《2026 年世界社会报告》。 该报告指出，经济、数字和能源转型正以前所未有的速度重塑世界， 但数十亿人仍被排除在就业、技能培训、公共服务、基础设施和社会保障之外，无法从这些变革中受益 。 2025 年约有 22 亿人无法接入互联网，已经联网的人群也受到网络服务费用高昂、服务质量不佳等因素的限制，难以真正参与数字社会。 IT之家从报告原文中获悉，联合国呼吁，如果不采取针对性措施，网络连接、数字设备、数据和 AI 技能方面的不平等， 可能让现有的数字鸿沟进一步扩大 ，使教育、收入和经济机会方面的差距更加严重，也更加难以消除。 报告还呼吁加强国际合作，拓展各国财政空间，建立更具代表性、包容性和回应能力的全球治理机制。 参考 As societies transform, people are falling behind, with rising costs of exclusion, new UN report warns
items.summary_en: The UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs' 2026 World Social Report says economic, digital and energy transitions are reshaping the world while billions remain excluded from jobs, skills, public services and social protection. About 2.2 billion people still lacked internet access in 2025, and the UN warns that without targeted measures, unequal connectivity, devices, data and AI skills could widen the digital divide and deepen gaps in education, income and opportunity.
items.why_zh: 这份报告用权威数据表明，数字与AI技能不平等正成为全球机会差距的结构性来源。
items.why_en: It frames digital and AI-skill inequality as a structural driver of widening global opportunity gaps.

items.title_zh: 给大模型装上“一双耳朵”：小米开源空间音频理解大模型 MiDashengLM-Spatial
items.title_en: Xiaomi Open-Sources MiDashengLM-Spatial, a Spatial Audio Understanding Model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，小米昨日宣布，带来 Dasheng 系列的重要新成员 ——MiDashengLM-Spatial，完整公开模型权重和推理代码，并以 Apache 2.0 许可证发布。 过去两年，小米先后发布并开源了声音基座模型 Xiaomi Dasheng 及声音理解大模型 MiDashengLM-7B 。相关技术已在小米智能家居、汽车座舱等场景实现超过 30 项落地应用，能够对语音、环境声音和音乐进行统一感知与理解。 据介绍，新模型以 MiDashengLM-7B 为基座，进一步为声音理解大模型赋予“一双耳朵”，使其不仅能够听懂声音的内容，还能感知声音来自何处、如何在空间中分布。 小米表示，MiDashengLM-Spatial 是 业界首个开源的端到端空间音频理解大模型 ，在保留基础音频理解能力的同时，具备空间感知与推理能力，推动音频大模型从“听懂声音”进一步迈向“理解声音所处的空间”。 该模型将陆续应用于小米智能家居、汽车座舱等场景，以空间听觉能力进一步提升“人车家全生态”的交互体验。相关测试数据如下： IT之家附相关链接： 项目主页： https://jinbo-hu.github.io/midashenglm-spatial-demo/ 技术报告： https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.11156 评估代码（GitHub）: https:…
items.summary_en: Xiaomi released MiDashengLM-Spatial with full model weights and inference code under the Apache 2.0 license. Built on MiDashengLM-7B, it adds spatial perception—where sound comes from and how it is distributed—and Xiaomi calls it the industry's first open-source end-to-end spatial audio understanding model, targeting smart home and car cockpit scenarios.
items.why_zh: 开源的空间音频理解能力为音频大模型从“听懂声音”走向“理解空间”提供了可复用基座。
items.why_en: It provides an open, reusable foundation for moving audio models from recognizing sound content to understanding space.

items.title_zh: Meta 首席 AI 官汪滔：不会开源最强模型，但会继续发布优秀开源模型
items.title_en: Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang: We Won't Open-Source Our Best Model, but Will Keep Shipping Strong Open Models
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，当地时间 10 月 15 日，Meta 发布了开放权重 AI 模型 Muse Spark Open。Meta 官方宣称这是迄今为止能力最强的美国开放权重模型。 据 The Next Web 报道，Meta 表示，Muse Spark Open 性能低于周一刚发布的前沿模型 Muse Wonder。 Meta 曾在周一宣布 Muse Wonder 已达到前沿模型水准，但并未对外公布任何基准测试成绩，该模型目前依然保持闭源。 Meta 首席 AI 官汪滔（Alexandr Wang）表示，出于安全与能力边界的双重考量， 我们通常不会开源我们最顶尖的模型 。不过他补充道，Meta 打算继续发布优秀的开源模型。 据悉，这是 Meta 旗下 Muse 系列 AI 模型的第二次开源。今年 8 月，Meta 以 Apache 2.0 协议发布了从 Muse Spark 蒸馏而成的 300 亿参数模型 Glimmer。 IT之家注意到，Meta 创始人五周前的言论与此截然相反。扎克伯格在 Sources 播客中表示，竞争对手训练出更先进的模型却不公开，是“极其危险”的行为（当时他并未具体点名任何企业）。 相关阅读： 《 Meta 发布 Muse Wonder 系列旗舰 AI 模型，对标 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 》 《 宣称“美国最强开源 AI 模型”…
items.summary_en: Meta released open-weight model Muse Spark Open on Oct 15, calling it its most capable open US model, though it trails the closed frontier model Muse Wonder, which has no published benchmarks. Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang said Meta generally won't open-source its top models, citing safety and capability boundaries, but will keep releasing strong open models. It is the Muse series' second open release after Glimmer in August.
items.why_zh: 头部厂商在“开源”与“保留最强模型”之间的取舍，折射出安全考量与竞争策略之间的张力。
items.why_en: It captures the tension between safety-driven caution and competitive strategy in releasing frontier models.

items.title_zh: 苹果 Minions 研究：闲置 Mac GPU 组队，几分钟就能完成 10 小时 AI 任务
items.title_en: Apple's Minions Research: Idle Mac GPUs Team Up to Finish a 10-Hour AI Job in Minutes
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 16 日消息，科技媒体 AppleInsider 昨日（10 月 15 日）发布博文，报道称苹果研究团队公布了一项名为 Minions 的系统研究， 尝试聚合闲置 Mac GPU，形成一个可动态调度的“虚拟 GPU 云”，用于运行大规模机器学习推理任务。 IT之家援引博文介绍，传统 AI 推理通常依赖集中式 GPU 集群，面临成本高、扩容慢、排队时间长等问题；而 Mac 在日常办公、浏览和创作场景中，GPU 常常长期空闲。 苹果公司在论文中阐述了 Minions 方案，希望重新组织这些“看不见的算力”，在不额外采购 GPU 的情况下，让多台 Mac 协同完成 AI 任务。 根据论文概述，系统由四个关键部分组成： Minion Server 负责接收任务、拆分子任务并协调调度； PostgreSQL 元数据存储 记录任务与设备状态； 运行在各台 macOS 设备上的 Minion Executor 通过 Apple Silicon GPU 本地执行推理； Minion Watchdog 则监控设备掉线、休眠或断电等情况，并把未完成任务重新分配给其他可用设备。 在技术实现上，Minions 采用“拉取式”任务模型：设备主动向服务器领取可执行的子任务，并通过原子化机制避免多台设备重复处理同一任务。推理结果可写入对象存储，系统还提供基于 Grafana 的实时监控面板，…
items.summary_en: Apple researchers unveiled Minions, a system that pools idle Mac GPUs into a dynamically scheduled "virtual GPU cloud" for large-scale ML inference. It combines a task-splitting server, PostgreSQL metadata, on-device executors running on Apple Silicon GPUs, and a watchdog that reassigns tasks when devices drop offline or sleep, using a pull-based task model to avoid duplicate work.
items.why_zh: 若闲置 Mac 算力可被有效聚合，将为集中式 GPU 集群之外提供一条低成本推理扩容路径。
items.why_en: Aggregating idle Mac compute could offer a low-cost alternative to centralized GPU clusters for scaling inference.
